content: svh = viewport with all browser UI shown (never changes), lvh = with UI hidden, dvh = current (jitters as toolbars collapse while scrolling). Support: Safari 15.4, Firefox 101, Chrome 108. Pattern for app shells: min-height:100vh fallback then min-height:100dvh (or 100svh where content must never be obscured, e.g. above a fixed bottom CTA). position:fixed elements anchor to the layout viewport, so pinch-zoom can move them offscreen regardless of dvh.
